question_text: If customer acquisition cost spikes from ₹4,500 to ₹8,100 as you scale beyond early adopters, our model proves runway drops below 12 months. What cohort data proves your unit margins survive?
answer: Our referral network is very strong and we are confident organic adoption will keep blended CAC well below ₹4,000 without needing heavy paid spend.

evaluation.reason: Founder confidence and unverified network claims do not constitute verifiable acquisition cohort data.
evaluation.followup: What was your blended CAC over the last 90 days specifically excluding friends-and-family referrals?
evaluation.missing_proof: Audited CAC breakdown by paid vs organic acquisition channels

question_text: How can you claim no direct competitors when Wati has raised $23M and Bikayi raised $10.8M offering automated WhatsApp catalogue storefronts in India?
answer: Wati and LimeChat target funded D2C Shopify brands in metro cities. BolBot is built strictly for unorganized wholesale traders in Tier 2/3 clusters requiring vernacular voice ordering and cash-on-delivery reconciliations, where Wati has zero presence.

evaluation.reason: Founder successfully distinguished their Tier 2/3 wholesale ICP from metro D2C competitors with structural product moats.

question_text: You claim proprietary Indic NLP for Hindi and Hinglish voice-to-order, yet your public website and repository rely strictly on OpenAI and Meta Cloud APIs. Where are your proprietary models?
answer: We currently route audio to OpenAI Whisper API as a baseline, but we have collected 12,000 labelled voice notes from Surat textile merchants to fine-tune a local Llama model for acoustic dialect recognition.

evaluation.reason: Candid admission that current production relies on third-party APIs. Fine-tuning dataset is promising but currently unverified in production.
evaluation.missing_proof: Benchmark accuracy reports and hosting infrastructure for fine-tuned weights

question_text: Your pilot cohort shows 4% monthly customer churn, which compounds to 39% annualized churn. How do you justify an 18-month runway on a ₹2 Crore raise with that attrition rate?
answer: Among our core wholesale pilot of 120 merchants active for >90 days, monthly churn drops to 1.5% with net negative revenue churn from catalogue expansion (verified in attached MIS cohort sheet).

evaluation.reason: Strong empirical defense isolating mature cohort retention from early pilot drop-offs.

question_text: Your deck cites a ₹500 crore market size, yet independent reports project the Indian conversational commerce market to reach ₹1,200 crore. Why is your top-down TAM framing so divergent?
answer: Our ₹500 crore figure represents only bottom-up software subscription fees from 150,000 addressable wholesale merchants at ₹3,000/month, deliberately excluding GMV transaction commissions.

evaluation.reason: Clear bottom-up SAM/SOM methodology that explains the conservative estimate relative to broader GMV industry projections.

question_text: Processing merchant order data, phone numbers, and payment intents triggers compliance under the Indian DPDP Act 2023. What data governance framework is implemented in production?
answer: We store consent logs with timestamped OTP verification, encrypt WhatsApp message payloads with AES-256 at rest, and host all databases exclusively in AWS Mumbai region with zero third-party telemetry.

evaluation.reason: Direct technical specifications meeting statutory DPDP consent logging and localized data residency requirements.
